mapper.select: SELECT a.tenant_id AS tenantId, a.merchant_id AS merchantId, a.id AS merchantAppId, a.app_id AS appId, a.api_secret AS apiSecret, a.sign_type AS signType, a.status AS appStatus, a.nonce_ttl_seconds AS nonceTtlSeconds, a.rate_limit_qps AS rateLimitQps, a.app_env AS appEnv, m.merchant_no AS merchantNo, m.status AS merchantStatus, m.risk_status AS riskStatus, m.default_currency AS defaultCurrency, m.country_code AS countryCode FROM merchant_app a INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = a.merchant_id AND m.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.app_id = #{appId} LIMIT 1
SELECT ip_pattern FROM merchant_api_ip_whitelist WHERE status = 1 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND ip_pattern IS NOT NULL AND ip_pattern != ''
